text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon kept practicing hard for the 
Satsuki Sho. However, her efforts hadn't 
shown much in the way of results yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They decide to seek help from Silence 
Suzuka, who shines brightly on turf 
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka captivates the audience 
whether she is running or singing. She was 
Smart Falcon's ideal inspiration as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While learning how to run from Silence 
Suzuka, Smart Falcon's desire for the 
Satsuki Sho grew even stronger.
